text: THREE STAGES of the writing. East chapel wall gives old, middle and newest versions. The second slot of each pair changes step by step: box-cross → wide → moon; seed → seed → horn; arrow stays arrow. E.g. middle (lamp wide)(egg seed)(wave arrow) becomes newest (lamp moon)(egg horn)(lean-mid arrow); middle (hornbox+dot wide)(mbox-saw wide) becomes (hornbox+dot moon)(mbox-saw moon). First-slot changes: wave+curl → wave → lean-mid.
